paper.title_en: Scalaron Quasinormal and Quasi-Bound Modes of Schwarzschild Black Holes in the Bondi-Sachs Formulation of Metric $f(R)$ Gravity
paper.abstract_en: We study scalaron quasinormal modes and quasi-bound states of Schwarzschild black holes directly within the Bondi-Sachs formulation of metric $f(R)$ gravity, combining frequency-domain analyses with characteristic time evolution. Starting from the linearised characteristic equations, we obtain the massive scalar master equation and show that the tensor master equation takes the same form as in general relativity. For the analytic models considered here, the linear scalar spectra depend on the $f(R)$ theory only through the dimensionless combination $μM$. We compute both quasinormal and quasi-bound spectral branches using Leaver's continued-fraction method and compare them with independent literature benchmarks. To complement the frequency domain analysis, we evolve the scalaron perturbation equations using a fourth order convergent characteristic scheme. Applying matrix-pencil stability scans to the resulting waveforms, we independently recover fundamental quasinormal frequencies consistent with the continued-fraction results within the measured extraction-stability scales. Finally, for a selected finite-mass case, we demonstrate the extraction of both oscillation frequencies and damping rates of the fundamental quasinormal mode and quasi-bound state from separate time windows of the same waveform at one extraction radius, without imposing either spectral branch at the finite outer boundary.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文将f(R)引力下的标量化子准正规模与准束缚态置于Bondi-Sachs形式体系中研究，属于引力理论基础方向，同时结合频域分析与特征时间演化两套独立方法，并对结果进行了交叉验证，理论深度和方法论严谨性信号较强，值得点击阅读全文。
decision.title_zh: 在度规$f(R)$引力的Bondi-Sachs表述中Schwarzschild黑洞的标量化子准正规模与准束缚模式
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在度规$f(R)$引力的Bondi-Sachs表述中直接研究Schwarzschild黑洞的标量化子准正规模和准束缚态，将频域分析与特征时间演化相结合。从线性化特征方程出发，我们得到了大质量标量主方程，并表明张量主方程与广义相对论中形式相同。对于此处所考虑的解析模型，线性标量谱仅通过无量纲组合$μM$依赖于$f(R)$理论。我们使用Leaver连分数方法计算准正规模和准束缚谱分支，并将其与独立的文献基准进行比较。为补充频域分析，我们使用四阶收敛的特征格式演化标量化子微扰方程。将矩阵束稳定性扫描应用于所得波形，我们在所测量的提取稳定性尺度内独立地重现了与连分数结果一致的基本准正规模频率。最后，对于一个选定的有限质量情形，我们展示了在同一个提取半径处、从同一波形的不同时间窗口提取基本准正规模和准束缚态的振荡频率与阻尼率，而无需在有限外边界处强加任一谱分支。
